scope:
Reversible nonnuclear spherical screen from exact source hot profiles.

Fixed entropy per cell; FEOS pressure on tabulated isentropes. No radiation,
viscosity, nuclear energy, grain breakup or contact injection. Reverse time is
represented by reversed velocity and outward evolution. This tests a smooth
fluid continuation, not upstream cold launch or physical reverse shocks.

adiabats.internal_energy_scope: Each cell is anchored to its exact initial FEOS u. Changes integrate the same interpolated P/rho² used by momentum, making work exchange conservative. FEOS energy-difference discrepancy measures EOS/table consistency.

numerics.message: The solver successfully reached the end of the integration interval.

interpretation: A continuous spherical fluid with a vacuum exterior is extended backward with fixed entropy. After a parcel reaches its declared postshock contact state, continuing it as fluid is an auxiliary boundary construction; the original incoming grains/contact geometry are not modeled. Convergence, nonnegative width and reversibility do not establish a globally shock-free continuum solution at all resolutions.
